hepkit_notebook.inspiration: Focused reactive controls, real shared graph and symbolic displays, short mathematical explanations, hidden presentation cells. TIRust source is independently written.

extension_guide.constraints: Actual upstream PyO3 types in one native host; no separately compiled native-kernel object mixing; algorithms and preparation remain Rust; bindings call existing Rust APIs directly.

feynkit_native_graph_renderer.inspection: The existing _repr_html_ path uses the native SVG renderer; no independent graph drawing or canonical Python constructor lookup is added.

benchmark_policy: Every TIRust ratio is TIRust/reference or TIRust(candidate)/TIRust(baseline). Historical reference-only IREGI/COLLIER times remain absolute; no cross-session TIRust/COLLIER ratio is fabricated.
